messages:
zahra (Billing): FYI Helios Data Labs (ACCT-HELIOS) card declined for INV-2025-07-312 ($29,600). they emailed asking for a 3-way split and are disputing one high-cost inference job.
mike (AE): spoke to their controller (ana). she says one job retried due to a webhook bug; will send logs and a usage CSV. asks if we can pause dunning while they respond.
omar (Collections): we can pause dunning with a temp hold but need a signed commitment before we stop recovery attempts. prefer signed email agreeing to timeline.
lina (Legal): include a clause that missed installment voids plan and resumes standard collections. i'll DM a short template.
pay-bot: Automated: retry 1/3 failed for INV-2025-07-312 (auth decline). next retry scheduled 2161243600.
zahra (Billing): billing note: any credit > $2k requires finance manager approval. if approved, apply after reconciliation only.
mike (AE): proposed plan: 30/30/40; first payment 10 days after signed reply. i'll ask them to sign and attach logs.
omar (Collections): once we have signed email + reconciliation CSV + payment method (ACH or card), i'll set payment_plan:pending to block dunning-bot.
mike (AE): ana replied: she'll sign tonight and prefers ACH. says logs attached. i'll post signed text when it comes through.
zahra (Billing): perfect. remind them ACH micro-deposits take 48-72h; if ACH not verified by first due date we'll attempt card.
omar (Collections): thanks. mike, drop the signed confirmation here and i'll take it from there.
mike (AE): will do. thanks everyone.
